decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither

It never says the second threading macro (PTHREAD or ALT) is also left undefined, so "both" is not stated. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in the default config (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`) | WHY: The answer says only MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is undefined by default; it never says the shipped config also leaves the second macro (PTHREAD or ALT) undefined. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in the default config (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`, `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). | WHY: The answer says THREADING_C is commented out by default but never says that the second threading macro (PTHREAD or ALT) is also left undefined in the shipped config.
